{{Top}}
{{Quote|Great gods of the waters, is Solo ''insane''? I know he doesn't drink liquor....|[[Cha Niathal]], commenting on the actions of [[Darth Caedus]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
'''Liquor''' was a strong [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage, classified among the alcoholic beverages known as [[Spirit (alcohol)|spirits]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> It was produced through processes of distillation<ref name="J11">{{JournalCite|11|The Most Dangerous Foe}} {{C|Roleplaying Game Statistics for [[Vici Ramunee]]}}</ref> (for example from [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]<ref name="IC">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>) and was often produced in a distillery factory.<ref name="J11" /> Liquor was quite expensive, and classified as a luxury good.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> Some people kept their bottles of liquor in a special liquor cabinet.<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref><ref name="Big Quince short story">{{JournalCite|2|Big Quince (short story)}}</ref><ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref><ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]]'' [[Seikosha/Legends|Seikosha]] was a major exporter of this beverage.<ref name="The Politics of Contraband">''[[The Politics of Contraband]]''</ref> Some types of liquor could be mixed with [[Caf/Legends|caf]].<ref name="R">[[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']]</ref>

==Types of liquor==
There were several types and brands of liquor, including [[Spice/Legends|spiced]] liquor,<ref name="Counterstrike Adventure Journal">{{JournalCite|8|Counterstrike (Adventure Journal)}}</ref> [[Shashay Idlewil Liquor|Idlewil liquor]], [[Lum/Legends|lum]],<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> [[Cognac/Legends|cognac]],<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron" /> [[Juri juice/Legends|juri juice]]<ref name="Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe">{{StoryCite|story=Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]],<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> [[Tihaar/Legends|tihaar]],<ref name="IC" /> [[namana liquor]], [[tuber liquor]],<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref> [[pulkay]],<ref name="R" /> [[Whiskey/Legends|whiskey]]<ref name="Honor Among Thieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref> and [[Twi'lek liquor/Legends|Twi'lek liquor]].
